criticalPathFindings.evidence: Static review of sveltekit-frontend/src/mcp/trace-mcp-server.ts initially found graph.expand_neighborhood accepted unbounded sourceRefs and atlas.packet_search accepted unbounded filters. The shared schema module caps graph seed count at 8, graph refs/filePath at 1,024 chars, graph labels at 512 chars, packet source_ref at 1,024 chars, feature/concept IDs at 256 chars, and packet summary query at 512 chars. The same handlers now cap serialized JSON at 128 KiB; graph's Neo4j fallback is read-only with a 5,000 ms transaction timeout, and packet search uses a read-only PostgreSQL transaction with a 2,000 ms statement timeout plus a 3,000 ms client query timeout. The separate FastMCP neighborhood/shortest-path tools now use capped paths/hops, read-routed Neo4j sessions, 5,000 ms transaction timeouts, and the shared 128 KiB serializer. The tuple evidence tool caps feature IDs at 256 chars, materializes at most 16 existing packet rows, caps serialized output at 128 KiB, and now runs nested canonical tracedQuery calls through one PostgreSQL READ ONLY transaction with a transaction-local 2,000 ms server-side statement_timeout. It no longer calls buildIndexedSourcePacket; that removed a source-fallback path whose implementation calls writeAcePacket with asLatest=true. The MCP response explicitly declares canonicalAuthority=false and writesPerformed=false. The tuple scope helper tests pass 3/3; tuple-path tests pass 2/2 and input/output bound tests pass 6/6; full svelte-check completed with 0 errors and 291 warnings across 100 files. Remaining ORF-7 gaps: no single wall-clock deadline covers non-database work, other search/evidence read tools are not comprehensively audited, and no hydrate tool is registered. This is source/fixture evidence only, not a live MCP request.
criticalPathFindings.implication: Keep ORF-7 open until all read surfaces have execution-time and serialized-output bounds and hydration has a proven canonical identity bridge. Do not add hydrate by guessing packet/chunk identity; Native P0.2's exact canonical join remains unproven.
